object-size.label: Object size
object-size.help: Size of each object, in KiB, MiB or GiB.

threads.label: Threads / client
threads.help: Parallel client threads on each client machine.

auto-terminate-seconds.label: Safety limit (seconds)
auto-terminate-seconds.help: Stop the run after this many seconds, even if objects remain.

object-data-compressibility.label: Compressibility (%)
object-data-compressibility.help: Share of each 4 KB chunk that is zero-filled. 0 is fully random.

object-data-dedupable.label: Allow deduplication
object-data-dedupable.help: Off stamps every 4 KB with a unique header so storage cannot dedupe it.

checksum.label: S3 checksum
checksum.help: Ask S3 to check each upload with this checksum algorithm. Off sends no checksum.

part-size.label: Part size
part-size.help: Upload each object in parts of this size. Empty sends each object in one request; must be smaller than the object size.

mpu-concurrent-objects.label: Concurrent multipart objects
mpu-concurrent-objects.help: How many objects may upload in parts at the same time. 0 is unlimited; needs a part size.

mpu-concurrent-parts.label: Concurrent parts per object
mpu-concurrent-parts.help: How many parts of one object upload at the same time. 0 is unlimited; needs a part size.

defer-verification.label: Defer verification
defer-verification.help: Stop after writing and verify later with read-verify. Not allowed with cleanup.

cleanup.label: Clean up verified objects
cleanup.help: Delete each successfully verified object after the run.

integrity-max-console-failures.label: Failure samples shown
integrity-max-console-failures.help: Corruption samples printed to the console. 0 hides them.

integrity-runtime-identity-tier.label: Engine identity check
integrity-runtime-identity-tier.help: Image proves one engine image across machines; payload also compares its files.

prefix-shards.label: Prefix shards
prefix-shards.help: How many prefix directories object keys are spread over. -1 picks a count from the concurrency; 0 keeps keys flat.

s3-driver.label: S3 driver
s3-driver.help: Default is SPT's Netty driver; aws uses the AWS SDK.

auth-version.label: Signature version
auth-version.help: Which S3 signature version signs each request. Version 4 is the current standard.

region.label: Region
region.help: AWS region for requests. Empty keeps the engine's selection.

endpoint-selection.label: Endpoint selection
endpoint-selection.help: Round-robin rotates over the endpoint's IPv4 addresses; per-request DNS resolves its hostname each time.

endpoint-hostname.label: Logical hostname
endpoint-hostname.help: Round-robin only: hostname for the Host header, signing and TLS SNI.

dns-timeout.label: DNS timeout
dns-timeout.help: How long one DNS lookup may take with per-request DNS. Empty uses 5s.

endpoint-connect-timeout.label: Connect timeout
endpoint-connect-timeout.help: How long a TCP connect may take with round-robin or per-request DNS. Empty uses 30s.

slice-endpoints.label: Slice endpoints across machines
slice-endpoints.help: Give each client machine its own share of the endpoints.

min-hosts.label: Minimum client machines
min-hosts.help: Start when at least this many machines connect. 0 requires all of them.

service-threads.label: Engine service threads
service-threads.help: Carrier threads for the engine's virtual threads. Empty uses the dashboard default, the thread count.

save-items.label: Save item list
save-items.help: Save items.csv with every created object. Can be large.
